youtube_title: Hair Falling In Bunches After Dengue? Don't Panic | Body Fix #11 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #11. Recovered from dengue or typhoid... and 2-3 months later hair falls in BUNCHES?
B is right. Usually TEMPORARY. It's called telogen effluvium.
Fever pushes hair into rest mode; it sheds 2-3 months later. Usually regrows in months.
Fix: Enough protein, full sleep, less stress, gentle with your hair.
Red flags: Bald patches, or still shedding after 6 months? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: AAD - Telogen effluvium
